title: Can a number plate cost more than the car?
note: Argument 01. Akeed's line (a plate can't cost more than the car) is the myth being corrected. The car, the plates and the rosette in the reel are toy models, not copies of real designs; 12345, 8642 and 371 are made up numbers.

facts.said: Plate P 7 sold for AED 55 million at an auction in Dubai on 8 April 2023.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, New record set as car number plate P7 sells for Dh55 million (8 Apr 2023)
Guinness World Records, Dubai driver drops nearly $15 million on most expensive license plate ever (May 2023)

facts.said: P 7 has one letter and one digit. The fewer the digits, the rarer and more expensive the plate.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, Dh55 million for a car number plate? Why they cost so much

facts.said: Guinness World Records lists it as the most expensive number plate ever sold.

sources.name: Guinness World Records, Dubai driver drops nearly $15 million on most expensive license plate ever (May 2023)

facts.said: It was a charity auction. All the money went to a food aid fund, the 1 Billion Meals Endowment.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, How UAE set a world record to feed the hungry (Apr 2023)
Khaleej Times, New record set as car number plate P7 sells for Dh55 million (8 Apr 2023)
